whatsNew.entry.9_5_3.title: Simulator reliability and transparency
whatsNew.entry.9_5_3.body: This update improves game accuracy, session recovery, localization, motion, and server-side transparency while preserving the play-token-only boundary.
whatsNew.entry.9_5_5.title: Expanded game catalog
whatsNew.entry.9_5_5.body: This release packages the accepted game catalog and correctness updates, localized Admin ledger labels, and a refreshed offline shell.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_5.title: Private-beta versioning and deployment runbook
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_5.body: This release moves the app to four-part private-beta versions, reserves 0.9.6.0 for the next large Claude product bundle, and documents the production pipeline in one plain-English runbook.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_6.title: Documentation truth pass and release recovery
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_6.body: This release packages the accepted documentation truth pass as the current private-beta patch while keeping 0.9.6.0 reserved for the next large Claude product bundle.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_8.title: Complete release package recovery
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_8.body: This release packages every host-required deployment script, keeps deterministic rollback and secret-safe monitor validation, and preserves 0.9.6.0 for the next product wave.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_9.title: Safer automated monitoring
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_9.body: This release loads the root-managed monitor credential without shell evaluation, preserves deterministic rollback, and keeps 0.9.6.0 reserved for the next product wave.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_10.title: Wallet and table-rule integrity
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_10.body: This release preserves committed ledger history during player creation, bounds Blackjack and Baccarat table rules on the server, keeps guest balances fixed, and retains deterministic rollback.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_11.title: Safer feedback and runtime state
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_11.body: This release protects URL bearers from client telemetry, makes failures visible and accessible, strengthens reduced-motion behavior, and rotates the offline shell safely.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_12.title: Reliable sign-in after logout
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_12.body: This release rotates the anonymous request-integrity token after logout or Guest Trial end so the next sign-in works without reloading the page.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_13.title: Reliability and integrity hardening
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_13.body: This release makes settlement replay safe across more games, strengthens request-integrity recovery, and brings the remaining governed regression suites into CI.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_14.title: TiltSeven enters the Neon Pit
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_14.body: This release carries the TiltSeven name, seven mark, Neon Pit venue, and reviewed neon palette across the private Casino experience.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_15.title: Repeat your last bet
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_15.body: This release adds a localized one-click Repeat bet control to the 43 games that previously lacked one while preserving exactly-once play and settled wager choices.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_16.title: Catalog governance clarified
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_16.body: This release records the 46 descriptor-discovered games and clarifies the historical 20-game target as a readiness floor rather than a catalog cap.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_17.title: Secret-safe timing foundation
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_17.body: This release adds bounded nginx timing families for operational latency diagnosis without logging raw paths, queries, identities, headers, cookies, or payloads.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_18.title: Transactional player persistence
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_18.body: This release inserts only missing player rows in one MySQL transaction without deleting or overwriting wallets, lifecycle state, ledger history, or action identities.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_19.title: Bounded MySQL connection lifecycle
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_19.body: This release reuses sanitized MySQL sessions through a bounded per-process pool with request-scoped cleanup, fail-closed deadlines, and secret-safe lifecycle evidence.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_20.title: Owner-gated Admin authority foundation
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_20.body: This release adds a server-side platform owner and owner-only additive-v2 Admin grant and revoke foundation with transaction-safe last-owner and last-Admin protections.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_21.title: Privacy-safe session-control foundation
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_21.body: This release adds bounded server-side session summaries and atomic revocation for retained accounts without exposing raw session identifiers, tokens, addresses, or client strings.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_22.title: Game rule-schema catalog gate
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_22.body: This release adds listener-free catalog validation for exact game settings routes, bounded rule domains, canonical defaults, and private schema metadata.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_23.title: Faster safe qualification
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_23.body: This release safely cancels superseded checks for one pull request and splits mandatory Long Suite 100 into four isolated shards.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_24.title: Safer game rule foundations
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_24.body: This release adds strict internal game-rule coercion helpers without changing live game settings or gameplay.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_25.title: Reliable Browser qualification
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_25.body: This release keeps dependent Browser cases on the same shard and verifies one exact 105-case result across four workers.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_26.title: Fair Acey-Deucey pricing
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_26.body: This release prices the inside wager by its visible spread and keeps equal or adjacent cards pass-only.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_27.title: Reachable game controls
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_27.body: This release verifies that enabled controls stay reachable in every registered game at both governed desktop sizes.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_28.title: Full-catalog load proof
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_28.body: This release proves three simultaneous players complete a governed action in every registered game with exact isolation and cleanup.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_65.title: Governed game ownership
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_65.body: This release gives every game an owned requirement shard and verifies shared suites through descriptor-driven discovery.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_66.title: Compact play responses
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_66.body: This release adds opt-in compact shell and Roulette responses while preserving complete legacy responses by default.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_67.title: Provider safety controls
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_67.body: This release adds independent default-off Google and Facebook operational switches without enabling public signup.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_68.title: Policy-gated social signup
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_68.body: This release adds disabled-by-default Google and Facebook signup into canonical Casino accounts without enabling provider traffic or public launch.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_69.title: Append-only ledger action journal
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_69.body: This release makes JSON exactly-once action writes append-only, cross-process visible, crash-recoverable, and periodically compacted without changing game or wallet behavior.
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_73.title: Verified email enrollment
whatsNew.entry.0_9_5_73.body: This release adds disabled-by-default verified email enrollment without creating an account, wallet, or session before confirmation.
